title: Calendar Helper
story: What day of the week was July 20, 1969? (Moon landing — Sunday.) How many days in February 2024? (29 — leap year!) Build a calendar helper that answers these questions — the same calculations that power every calendar app on every device.
why: Calendar calculations teach modular arithmetic, leap-year rules, and the fascinating math behind day-of-week formulas — practical date manipulation.
analogy: A wall calendar where you flip to any month of any year. Your calendar helper is the math behind the calendar: '30 days hath September...' encoded as code, leap year rules for February, and Zeller's formula to find the day of the week for any date in history.
try_it: Implement day_of_week using the simpler 'Doomsday algorithm'. Print a full month calendar as a formatted grid. Calculate how many days until your next birthday. Find all Friday the 13ths in a given year.
tips: Leap year rule: every 4th year, EXCEPT centuries, EXCEPT every 4th century
Zeller's formula handles all Gregorian dates since 1582
Days before a year can be computed as: 365 * y + y/4 - y/100 + y/400
common_mistakes: Getting leap year wrong: 1900 is NOT leap, 2000 IS leap
January and February treated as months 13 and 14 of the PREVIOUS year in Zeller
